messages.author: 73fb61795976b321
messages.subject: Re: calculate the score of a new dataset using the parameters of a work done previously
parts:
Silvio,

Try this.

Get a parameter structure with the pars="values" option and change the parameters to your values and run fscores(). I think Phil wrote a shortcut to this but I could not find...

Hope this helps.

Hugo

-------------------------------

parameters <- mirt( data=your_data,
                    model=1,
                    itemtype='3PL',
                    technical=list(NCYCLES=1000),
                    pars="values")

for(i in 1:item_number)){
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "a1")),]$value <- pars[i,"a"]
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "d")),]$value <- pars[i,"d"]
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "g")),]$value <- pars[i,"c"]
 
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "a1")),]$est <- FALSE
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "d")),]$est <- FALSE
  parameters[ ((parameters$item == paste0("Q",i)) & (parameters$name == "g")),]$est <- FALSE
}

mod_mt <- mirt( data=your_data,
                model=1,
                itemtype='3PL',
                technical=list(NCYCLES=10000),
                pars = parameters)

coef(mod_mt,simplify=TRUE,IRTpars = TRUE)
profic_mt_raw = fscores(mod_mt) #estimativas das proficiÃªncias individuais

messages.subject: Re: calculate the score of a new dataset using the parameters of a work done previously
parts:
Hi Silvio,

This was definitely a missing itemtype in the generate.mirt_object() function. I've added a constructor for it, but note that mirtCAT does not currently support its use in CATs just yet (for various reasons). You can, however, use this object stub for a number of other purposes, such as scoring individuals, so in that sense the objects generated should work as one would expect with mirt. HTH.

Phil
